name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Partner GTM Manager
summary: Partner and channel GTM professional with direct experience enabling reseller partners to package, position, and sell SaaS solutions to SMB customers. At Birdeye, owned a portfolio of 15-20 reseller partners, developing enablement workflows and automated training sequences that drove adoption and sustained roughly 94% retention. At Wix, a website platform for professionals and SMBs much like Duda, onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets. Bring the agency side too (Level Agency, Fetch & Funnel), understanding how the large media agencies Duda partners with actually operate. Now build AI-driven automation and GTM systems at Solenzo for SMB service businesses, translating complex capabilities into the positioning and enablement assets partners need to sell.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding

Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and drove partner adoption of new features.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own SMB customers.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority partner feedback informing the roadmap.
